sources.use: Examination posture matters; no medical claim that every joint-limit combination is a normal posture.
Everyday neck tasks studied separately from maximal physiological ROM; not used to discard the existing 35 degree neck tilt.
684ZZ 4 x 9 x 4 mm; basic static radial rating 225 N. Rating applies to specified bearing, not arbitrary lookalikes.
MR126ZZ 6 x 12 x 4 mm; static 292 N, dynamic 790 N.
A2-70 minimum 0.2% proof stress 450 MPa; all load-carrying nuts and screws require a stated property class.
Cold rolled 304 minimum yield 230 MPa, elastic modulus 200 GPa; applied as a procurement specification, not an as-measured result.

Austenitic slotted spring pin minimum double shear: D1.5 1.0 kN, D2 2.0 kN, D3 4.5 kN. Recommended holes D1.5:1.50-1.56, D2:2.00-2.07, D3:3.00-3.10 mm. Installed envelope is modelled; free diameter is larger.
Custom shafts: certified yield >=750 MPa. Lumbar flexion: certified 6115 / 42CrMnMo4-4 +QT, minimum 940 MPa retained after machining; source stock 25–60 mm. Not a rating for generic annealed rods.
Steel retaining compound reference. The design uses a separately qualified 2 MPa shear allowable, not the advertised typical strength as a guaranteed joint rating.
Three-axis sensing, angle calculation and gain/offset compensation. Only ideal observability is validated; no populated board or measured magnetic accuracy is claimed.
